description: This file contains classes and functions for handling XML schemas related to database structure, including schema parsing, conversion, and SQL generation for database objects like tables, indexes, and data, specifically for the ADOdb library in PHP.

classes.name: dbObject
classes.description: Base class for database objects providing common methods for platform support, prefix handling, and field ID extraction.

classes.name: dbTable
classes.description: Represents a database table, with methods for schema parsing, SQL generation, and object management.

classes.name: dbIndex
classes.description: Represents a database index, with methods for schema parsing, SQL generation, and object management.

classes.name: dbData
classes.description: Represents data within a table, with methods for loading, processing, and generating SQL for data manipulation.

classes.name: dbQuerySet
classes.description: Handles a set of SQL queries, supporting building, prefixing, and execution of queries.

classes.name: adoSchema
classes.description: Main class for loading, parsing, converting, and applying XML database schemas, including version management and schema transformation.

methods.name: setUpgradeMethod
methods.description: Sets the upgrade method for existing schemas (ALTER, REPLACE, etc.).

methods.name: existingData
methods.description: Configures how to handle existing data rows during schema updates (insert, update, ignore).

methods.name: executeInline
methods.description: Enables or disables inline execution of SQL as schema is parsed.

methods.name: continueOnError
methods.description: Enables or disables continuing schema execution after errors.

methods.name: parseSchema
methods.description: Loads an XML schema file and generates SQL for database creation.

methods.name: parseSchemaString
methods.description: Parses an XML schema string and generates SQL for database creation.

methods.name: removeSchema
methods.description: Loads a schema file and generates SQL to remove the described database objects.

methods.name: removeSchemaString
methods.description: Generates SQL to uninstall the database described by a schema string.

methods.name: executeSchema
methods.description: Applies the generated SQL schema to the database, creating or updating objects.

methods.name: printSQL
methods.description: Returns the current SQL array in specified format.

methods.name: saveSQL
methods.description: Saves the current SQL array to a file.

methods.name: create_parser
methods.description: Creates and initializes an XML parser for schema processing.

methods.name: _tag_open
methods.description: Handles start XML tags during parsing, creating schema objects accordingly.

methods.name: _tag_cdata
methods.description: Handles character data within XML tags during parsing.

methods.name: _tag_close
methods.description: Handles end XML tags during parsing, finalizing schema objects.

methods.name: convertSchemaString
methods.description: Converts an XML schema string to a different DTD version.

methods.name: convertSchemaFile
methods.description: Converts a schema file to a different DTD version.

methods.name: transformSchema
methods.description: Transforms schema XML using XSLT for version conversion.

methods.name: schemaFileVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the schema version from a schema file.

methods.name: schemaStringVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the schema version from a schema string.

methods.name: extractSchema
methods.description: Generates an XML schema from an existing database, optionally including data.
